name: Retro Fighter
storyline:
An inner-city narcotics investigator by the name of Maria, the girlfriend of a renown Martial Arts teacher called Tommy Lee was Kidnapped by a street gang known as the Dark syndicate, led by a deadly and ruthless Drug - Lord going by the name of Carlos. She disappeared a couple of days after months of undercover work trying to infiltrate their criminal organisation. Tommy arrived on the scene just as the villains made away with the her, forcing him to hit the streets for an all-out rescue attempt.
It will take all of your incomparable fighting Techniques, skills and knowledge to find and rescue Maria from sudden death. You and you alone must face the fearsome onslaught of Carlos and his Dark syndicate.
summary: A game inspired by the Double Dragon and Streets of Rage series of games.
